introHtml: Non slip knives blocks sets combine the precision of a quality blade with a stable, rubberized block that stays put on countertops. For commercial kitchens, break rooms, or company swag, the non slip feature prevents accidents and keeps your logo visible. Decorate the block or blade with your mark using laser engraving or pad printing for a professional finish that lasts.
